_: Every divergence from the frozen subpages spec, with the reason it exists. scripts/parity-check.mjs fails on a divergence that is not declared here AND on a declaration that no longer describes one, so this file cannot quietly become a list of things the check has stopped looking at. Keys beginning with _ are notes, not declarations.

.addr.why: CLOSES TWO PROPERTIES globals.css SETS ON `code` THAT THE DESIGN DOES NOT NAME - #575's leak family, in SDE-UI's own words in the sheet: globals styles `code` with the retired palette's surface and a border radius of 0, and the design's address block sets its own background, border and radius while saying nothing about background-clip or box-shadow. Without these an address renders in the retired palette inside an otherwise correct box.
.addr.shipped: background-clip:padding-box; box-shadow:none || display:block; word-break:break-all; font:500 calc(.95*var(--u))/1.45 var(--mono); color:var(--ink); background:var(--prompt-bg); border:calc(.06*var(--u)) solid var(--prompt-border); border-radius:calc(.6*var(--u)); padding:calc(.8*var(--u)) calc(1*var(--u)); margin:0 0 calc(.9*var(--u))

.view.sub .card.claim.why: THE SUBPAGE CARD IS A SCROLL BOX AND THE INDEX CARD IS NOT. The subpages put a long document inside the same `.card.claim` the index uses for a short form, so the card becomes a column that fills its view and hands the overflow to the panel. The design has no rule because its subpages are separate mocks rather than the index's card reused.

.view.sub .card.claim > .card-copy.why: The fixed half of the same column: the heading block does not scroll, so it is `flex:none` while the panel below it takes the rest.

.view.sub .card.claim > .panel.why: The scrolling half of that column: `flex:1 1 auto; min-height:0; overflow:auto` is what lets the panel take the remaining height and scroll inside it rather than growing the card past the viewport. min-height:0 is load-bearing - without it a flex child refuses to shrink below its content and the overflow never engages.

body.why: THE DROPPED HALF OF ONE RE-SCOPING. We ship nothing under the design's own `body`; the rule is shipped as `html body`, which carries the body and its reason. The subpages spec is the WHOLE terms.html style block, so it carries the shell rules this page shares with the index and reports them here too - one divergence, once per spec that contains it.
